app.title: NanoCore Editor
app.subtitle: Unofficial online editor for the Livtra NanoCore mini multi-effect processor
app.noPedalNotice: The server is not connected to a pedal right now. It keeps trying; the editor updates when the pedal is back.
app.noServerNotice: This page is not served by nanocore serve, so there is no pedal to talk to. Run nanocore serve and open the address it prints.

routing.warning: FX2 is set to {{type}}, which reuses MOD's parameter CCs (68-73). Editing MOD parameters right now will actually change FX2's {{type}} instead.

rename.label: Preset name
rename.buttonTitle: Change the name of the preset (up to 8 characters)
rename.applyTitle: Rename the preset (it stays unsaved until you save)

file.downloadTitle: Save this preset to a file on your computer
file.uploadTitle: Replace the content of this preset with a file (applied live, not stored until you save)
file.uploadConfirm: Replace the content of the current preset with this file? It is applied live; press save to keep it.

tuner.note: Sends CC80 (0 = off, 127 = on) to remotely open/close the on-device tuner. The reference pitch (default 440Hz) is only adjustable on the device itself — no CC is documented for it.

settings.toggleTitle: Settings of the pedal itself (loopback, input gain, volumes, MIDI channel, Bluetooth)
settings.title: Pedal settings
settings.wirelessWarning: Turning it off drops the Bluetooth connection, also the one this editor may be using.
settings.readOnly: The server is read-only: the settings cannot be changed.
settings.readError: The settings could not be read from the pedal.
settings.writeError: The setting could not be changed. Showing what the pedal has.

models.toggleTitle: Amplifier and cabinet models stored in the pedal: save them to files or replace them
models.title: Amplifier and cabinet models
models.ampNote: Models read from a pedal can be written here. Livtra's encrypted .ead files need a decryptor that you provide (docs/ead-decryptor.md); none is configured on this server.
models.readOnly: The server is read-only: nothing can be written.
models.downloadTitle: Save this model to a file on your computer
models.uploadAmpTitle: Replace this model with a .bin file read from a pedal, or an .ead file
models.uploadIrTitle: Replace this cabinet with a .wav or .bin file
models.confirm: Replace '{{name}}' in slot {{slot}}? The old content is kept in a backup on the computer running the server.
models.tooLarge: The file is larger than 4 MiB.
models.readError: The models could not be read from the pedal.
models.ampNoteEad: Models read from a pedal can be written here, and Livtra's .ead files through your decryptor.

calibration.badge: firmware differs from the measured one
calibration.hint: The pedal reports a different parameter layout than the one this editor was measured against.
calibration.hidden: Parameter values are hidden because this pedal reports a different layout than the measured firmware.

error.unauthorized: The server rejected the access token. Reload the page using the address printed by nanocore serve.
error.readOnly: The server is in read-only mode. Your change was not sent.
error.forbidden: The server refused the request (host or origin check).
error.slotChanged: The active preset changed on the pedal. Your change was not applied; the editor now shows the current preset.
error.rateLimitedLost: Too many edits at once. The last change was not applied.
error.rateLimited: Too many edits at once. Retrying…
error.disconnected: The pedal is not connected. Your change was not applied.
error.timeoutMaybe: The pedal did not answer. The change may or may not have been applied; the editor shows what the pedal reports.
error.timeout: The pedal did not answer. Your change was not applied.
error.invalid: The server rejected the change as invalid.
error.tooLarge: The request was too large for the server.
error.network: The editor lost contact with the server.
error.invalidFile: The file is not valid JSON, so it is not a preset file.
error.fileTooLarge: The file is too large to be a preset file.
